description: A flower planted in a garden on atpota.to: atpota.to's community patches, or anyone's own garden. How many each account can have in a garden's open patches is up to the garden (its patch's planting): by default one, which stays where it was first planted. Flowers in patches that have closed stay, pressed.

patch.description: The patch the flower grows in: a to.atpota.garden.patch record, in atpota.to's repo (did:plc:qntsxa2i4sb24noi45fx4np2) for the community patches, or in the garden owner's.

kind.description: The kind its planter picked, or "seed": the garden decides what it grows into, from the seed itself, the patch's season and the network weather the minute it was planted, and shows it when it blooms.

plot.description: The plot in its patch, counted from the top left, row by row. If an earlier flower already has it, this one moves to the next free plot.
